sentences.text:
Present: Mr. Manohar Lal
Sharma, Advocate, for applicants/respondents No.2 & 4.
of Mr. Ashutosh Bhardwaj, Advocate, for the appellant.
Learned counsel for the applicant intends to withdraw these applications.
Hence, these applications are dismissed as withdrawn.
CMP No. 10683 of 2023
The present application has been filed on behalf of applicant/appellant No.2. for seeking the release of the amount in FAO No.280 of 2009.
It has been asserted that the applicant was minor at the time of passing of the award.
Now, he has attained majority.
He requires money because he has no source of income.
Therefore, he has prayed that the present application be allowed.
No reply is intended to be filed to the application.

The copy of the matriculation certificate has been filed, which shows that applicant was born on 01.01.2002, therefore, appellant has attained majority and is entitled to the compensation awarded in his favour.
The original award shows that the main appeal has been disposed of.
No appeal has been filed against this order.
Therefore, the applicant is entitled to the money awarded to him.

Consequently, the present application is .
allowed and the amount is ordered to be remitted to the applicant through his Saving Bank Account details of which are given in para-6 of the application, after proper verification of the documents.
